title: Work Order — a production order that consumes a BOM once
description: A work order is the only document in this lane whose completion moves stock twice: the components leave the source warehouse and the produced item enters the target one. It cites the BOM it consumes rather than copying its component list, so a corrected BOM corrects every order raised from it — and item is required to agree with the BOM's output item, because an order that produces something other than its bill describes is a different order than the one declared.

bom.description: The bill of materials consumed. Cited, never copied: the order reads the components at completion.

item.description: The item produced. Must equal the BOM's output item — checked at completion and refused by name.

quantity.description: How much to produce. Drives the explosion: each component's quantity is scaled by quantity/BOM.quantity.

produced_quantity.description: Written when the order completes: what was actually produced, which is the quantity the stock ledger receives.

harvest: the work order field surface (bom link, produced item, quantity, source and target warehouse)
completion as the point where components are consumed and output is received
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream work order doctype, re-expressed as our own schema and workflow data. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
